nodes.name: Ambil Data Produk Olsera
nodes.notes: Pilih credential HTTP Header Auth milik Olsera setelah workflow diimpor. Uji output respons sebelum mengaktifkan jadwal.

nodes.name: Validasi & Map Produk
nodes.notes: Node ini sengaja gagal jika format respons tidak dikenali, daftar produk kosong, atau id/nama produk tidak tersedia.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO products (
  olsera_id,
  name,
  sku,
  price,
  buy_price,
  stock,
  weight,
  description,
  category,
  brand,
  image_url,
  is_active,
  source_updated_at,
  raw_payload,
  last_seen_at,
  synced_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  NULLIF($3, ''),
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  $7,
  NULLIF($8, ''),
  NULLIF($9, ''),
  NULLIF($10, ''),
  NULLIF($11, ''),
  $12,
  $13::timestamptz,
  $14::jsonb,
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (olsera_id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  sku = EXCLUDED.sku,
  price = EXCLUDED.price,
  buy_price = EXCLUDED.buy_price,
  stock = EXCLUDED.stock,
  weight = EXCLUDED.weight,
  description = EXCLUDED.description,
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  brand = EXCLUDED.brand,
  image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url,
  is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
  source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,
  raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload,
  last_seen_at = NOW(),
  synced_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING olsera_id, name, synced_at;

nodes.name: Upsert Produk ke PostgreSQL
nodes.notes: Pilih credential PostgreSQL Grandivo setelah workflow diimpor. Query menggunakan parameter $1-$14, bukan interpolasi SQL.
